design_basis: Published input/output schemas and author CSV clarification; no implementations existed at case design.

cases.name: quoted_newlines_and_blank_record
cases.rationale: CSV logical records differ from physical lines; a blank CSV record is not a two-empty-cell row.

cases.name: exact_duplicate_and_blank_headers
cases.rationale: Empty header and empty cell positions remain distinct and positional.

cases.name: extra_fields_do_not_expand_baseline
cases.rationale: Confirmed contract: report extra width but do not invent additional baseline columns.

cases.name: empty_without_header
cases.rationale: Empty document has zero records and no inferred columns.

cases.name: unterminated_quote
cases.rationale: Strict dialect parser must refuse an unterminated quoted field.

cases.name: nul_input
cases.rationale: NUL is outside the declared CSV string contract.

cases.name: duplicate_same_value_key
cases.rationale: Raw duplicate names must be refused.

cases.name: trailing_garbage
cases.rationale: A valid prefix is not a valid complete document.

cases.name: invalid_utf8
cases.rationale: Invalid UTF-8 must produce the declared refusal, not a traceback.

cases.name: wire_byte_limit
cases.rationale: Leading whitespace still counts toward the declared input byte limit.

cases.name: multiplicities_types_and_missing
cases.rationale: Booleans must not collapse into integers; absent keys differ from null; counts cannot collapse into sets.

cases.name: input_permutation
cases.rationale: Row order cannot alter canonical multiset reconciliation.

cases.name: field_order_and_integral_numbers
cases.rationale: Canonical key order and exact integer normalization preserve equality.

cases.name: empty_multisets
cases.rationale: Empty bags compare equal.

cases.name: nonintegral_row_number
cases.rationale: Fractional values require strings under this explicit row contract.

cases.name: rounding_must_not_fabricate_integer
cases.rationale: Binary float rounding must not convert a nonintegral wire number into integer 1.

cases.name: nonfinite_number
cases.rationale: Nonfinite values are not JSON primitives.

cases.name: duplicate_same_value_key
cases.rationale: Raw duplicate names must be refused.

cases.name: trailing_garbage
cases.rationale: A valid prefix is not a valid complete document.

cases.name: invalid_utf8
cases.rationale: Invalid UTF-8 must produce the declared refusal, not a traceback.

cases.name: wire_byte_limit
cases.rationale: Leading whitespace still counts toward the declared input byte limit.

cases.name: exact_cdf_thresholds_and_duplicate_values
cases.rationale: Strictly above a jump differs from exact equality; equal decimal values combine without interpolation.

cases.name: sample_permutation
cases.rationale: Input order cannot alter sorted inverse-CDF results.

cases.name: positive_weight_scale_invariance
cases.rationale: Uniform weight scaling preserves all quantile values exactly.

cases.name: negative_zero_and_integral_weight
cases.rationale: Canonical decimal zero and schema-compatible integral JSON weight.

cases.name: zero_weight_refused
cases.rationale: This method explicitly requires positive integer weights.

cases.name: probability_above_one
cases.rationale: Probability grammar excludes values above one.

cases.name: near_integer_weight_not_rounded
cases.rationale: Exact lexical value is nonintegral despite ordinary binary-float rounding.
